- Drive the “Celestial” vehicle with a minigun mounted on top!

• 6 new weathers roll into every world: Rain, Thunderstorm, Blizzard, Aurora, Meteor Shower & Windfall!
• Each storm boosts that area's boxes & eggs: more drops, x4 secret luck, better Shiny & Void odds and more
• New weather every 30 minutes, and every server gets it at the same time
• Find the Weather Machine in Rainforest to see the forecast, or summon any weather for your whole server!
• Meteors land just for you: crack them open for boosters, potions & materials
• All 9 worlds now share one server: hop between worlds in seconds with your friends
• Rebuilt Box Pass with no daily cap and no tier limit
• Double Shiny & Void Boosters from Gold Rush, Box Trials & Hard dungeons
• And much more!
